greeting.desconocido.1: A stranger? I haven't seen you around %2$s.
greeting.desconocido.2: Good day. Have you come far?
greeting.desconocido.3: Hello, traveller. We are quiet folk here.

greeting.conocido.2: Your face rings a bell. You helped with something on the board, didn't you?
greeting.conocido.3: Good day, %1$s. What brings you to %2$s?

greeting.amigo.1: %1$s, my friend! Sit down a moment.
greeting.amigo.2: So glad to see you. They speak well of you in %2$s.
greeting.amigo.3: Look who's back! Come in, come in.

greeting.heroe.1: The hero of %2$s! The children won't stop talking about you.
greeting.heroe.2: %1$s, it's an honour. Whatever you need.

reputation.desconocido.1: We're a bit wary of strangers here. Nothing personal.
reputation.desconocido.2: If you want to be known, look at the board on the square.

reputation.conocido.1: The bailiff says you keep your word. That counts for a lot here.
reputation.conocido.2: They don't look at you funny at the market any more, have you noticed?

reputation.amigo.1: I keep the best of the week for you, just so you know.
reputation.amigo.2: You have a home in %2$s whenever you want.

reputation.heroe.1: Someday someone will write a song about you. I hope it rhymes.
reputation.heroe.2: As long as you're around, we sleep soundly.

family.llanuras.1: From here you can see anyone coming a league away.
family.llanuras.2: The plains wind carries off your worries and your hat.

family.bosque.1: There are mushrooms in the forest that heal and some that don't. Learn which are which.
family.bosque.2: The birches sing when the wind blows. Listen.

family.oscuro.1: Under these oaks it is never quite daytime.
family.oscuro.2: Don't stray from the lanterns after nightfall. Trust me.

family.taiga.1: The spruces smell of resin and of winter coming.
family.taiga.2: Around here the foxes even steal the eggs from the henhouse.

family.nieve.1: Here you learn quickly never to let the fire go out.
family.nieve.2: The snow covers everything, even the wolves' tracks.

family.desierto.1: Water is worth more than gold here. Well, almost.
family.desierto.2: By day it scorches and by night it freezes. The desert knows no middle ground.

family.sabana.1: The acacias give little shade, but they give it to everyone alike.
family.sabana.2: The wild horses come down to drink at sunset.

family.jungla.1: In the jungle everything grows, especially what you don't want.
family.jungla.2: The parrots repeat what we say. Mind your words.

family.pantano.1: The swamp mist hides more than it seems.
family.pantano.2: The frogs sing all night. You get used to it. More or less.

family.cerezos.1: When the petals fall it looks like pink snow.
family.cerezos.2: The cherry-blossom bees make the sweetest honey around.

family.badlands.1: This red earth holds gold, if you know where to look.
family.badlands.2: The abandoned mines creak at night. I wouldn't go near them.

family.costa.1: The sea brings everything: fish, driftwood and the odd bottle.
family.costa.2: When the lighthouse goes dark, we know a storm is coming.

time.morning.1: Getting up early in %2$s is easy: the rooster shows no mercy.
time.morning.2: A good day to start something new, don't you think?

time.afternoon.1: At this hour only the cats nap in peace.
time.afternoon.2: Half the work is already done. The other half, tomorrow.

time.evening.1: The sun is setting. We'll have to shut ourselves in soon.
time.evening.2: At this hour the sky over %2$s turns every colour.

time.night.1: What are you doing up at this hour? There are zombies out there.
time.night.2: At night you hear strange things beyond the wall.

weather.clear.1: What a clear day. You can see all the way to the horizon.
weather.clear.2: In this sun, washing dries in no time.

weather.rain.1: This rain is good for the fields but bad for my knees.
weather.rain.2: If it keeps raining like this, the river will burst its banks.

weather.snow.1: More snow. We'll have to clear the roof again.
weather.snow.2: In this cold even the skeletons shiver.

weather.thunder.1: That lightning struck close! Keep away from the trees.
weather.thunder.2: In a storm not even creepers come out. Well, they do.

general.1: Life in %2$s is simple, and I like it that way.
general.2: The iron golem has looked at me oddly since I painted a flower on it.
general.3: The well on the square gives the freshest water around.
general.4: They say the mayor snores so loud he scares the bats.
general.5: Take care, %1$s. The world is big and not always kind.

rumor.1: They say a merchant came through last night with three llamas and no hurry at all.
rumor.2: The smith's daughter is engaged. Or so she says.
rumor.3: Someone has seen strange lights in the hills. I'm sure it's nothing.
rumor.4: In the next village they bake horrible bread. Don't tell them I said so.
rumor.5: We haven't seen the wandering trader for days. I hope he's well.

busy.1: Not now, I have work to do. If you want to trade, go ahead.
busy.2: We'll talk later, my stew is burning.
busy.3: Give me a while, you've caught me busy.

farewell.2: Come back whenever you like. We'll be here.
farewell.4: Until next time. And don't forget %2$s.

hint.unique.1: I'll tell you something nobody knows: when I was young I saw ‘%1$s’, to the %2$s, about %3$s blocks away. I never went back.
hint.unique.2: My father used to tell me about ‘%1$s’. It lies to the %2$s, about %3$s blocks away. They say something guards it.
hint.unique.3: If you want real adventure: ‘%1$s’, to the %2$s, about %3$s blocks away. I turned back at the gate.

hint.medium.1: When I travelled I stopped at a place like that: ‘%1$s’, to the %2$s, about %3$s blocks from here.
hint.medium.2: To the %2$s, about %3$s blocks away, there's ‘%1$s’. Ask for me if anyone is still there.
hint.medium.3: Don't tell anyone: ‘%1$s’, to the %2$s, about %3$s blocks. Worth the walk.

hint.mine.1: There's ‘%1$s’ to the %2$s, about %3$s blocks away. I went down once and heard picks in the dark.
hint.mine.2: If you're after ore, ‘%1$s’, to the %2$s, about %3$s blocks away. Take plenty of torches.

hint.withheld.1: I've seen the world, yes... but I don't tell just anyone. Earn the trust of %2$s.
hint.withheld.2: I know of a place, but I don't know you well enough yet, %1$s.
hint.withheld.3: Help out a bit on the board and maybe I'll tell you what I saw on my travels.

hint.told.1: I've already told what I know. The rest you'll have to find out yourself.
hint.told.2: My secret is already told. Maybe someone else in %2$s knows more.

hint.nothing.1: I travelled a lot, but around here I saw nothing worth telling.
hint.nothing.2: What I saw on my travels is too far from here.
